feeds.title: Atlanta Petanque League Blog
feeds.description: If you want to know more about the game, meet new players, and Compete in the upcoming Leagues. We recommend you to read our blogs. Come discover why this fun, social game for all ages and easy to learn; but a challenge to master!

feeds.title: Pen-Y-Coed Petanque Blog
feeds.description: In our blog, We share all information related to petanque Events Competition listings, Boule Coaching Tips, Petanque Club News, and Equipment Latest news. Established in 1994, Our aim is to share with you all information about the best Petanque equipment available and let you enjoy your sport to the full, knowing you will be using the finest quality boule and accessories.

feeds.title: All About Petanque
feeds.description: Our Blog consists of everything you want to know about petanque. We share all information about the petanque game, rules, events, and how to build a petanque terrain. We also share information about its history, features, facts, and legends.

feeds.title: The Rules of Petanque
feeds.description: Want to know about the rules of the Petanque? Then you are in the right place. Here we share all information about the rules of playing Petanque and keep you updated.

feeds.title: Southern Counties Petanque Blog
feeds.description: Southern Counties Pétanque Association is one of sixteen regions of Pétanque England, devoted to promoting the sport of Pétanque and represents 22 petanque clubs across the south. We share all information about the different events that are held in different clubs, membership, and coaching provided by them. We also provide updates about the rules and results of different major leagues.

feeds.title: Carolina Petanque
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Carolina. I share all updates regarding when and where the Federation of Petanque, USA hosts its events, and to get all the information related to it including the players, rules, and winners.

feeds.title: Suffolk Coastal Petanque Alliance Blog
feeds.description: In our blog, we share information about the events hosted by our club and also about the external events that our players take part in. The history of the Suffolk Coastal Petanque Alliance starts back in 2007, Tasked with the mission of gathering these potential players together by hosting many different events.

feeds.title: Heckmondwike Petanque Club
feeds.description: Heckmondwike Petanque Club shares all information about the exciting game for all ages, imported from Europe and also known as boules. Follow our blog to get every update on the events that are held by HPC.

feeds.title: Classic City Petanque Club Blog
feeds.description: Classic City Petanque Club was officially formed in August 2018. Here you will get the information about the events that we organize. Our goal is to promote the Petanque game and spread joy among the ones who love it. Come play with us!

feeds.title: Bayside Boules - Alden Park
feeds.description: Hi! We are Ciaran Walsh and Tom Donnellan. Here you will find all updates related to the Petanque Leagues held at the Alden Park. We cover everything from event dates to match results. If you love playing Petanque you're going to enjoy this!

feeds.title: London Pétanque Club
feeds.description: Bringing you all the updates of pétanque events from around the UK & Europe. Find out the latest results for club events and non-club events featuring LPC players. We hold several club events throughout the year suiting players of all levels and abilities. London Pétanque Club members also compete regularly at the very top level of the sport both Nationally and Internationally with both male and female representatives from the club having played for England.

feeds.title: Carreau Club
feeds.description: Carreau Club blogs will give you all the information about the petanque tournaments that is been organized by the club. If you want to know more about the game, players, and the winners of the tournaments, Hop On!

feeds.title: Legation Boules Club Blog
feeds.description: The Legation Boules Club blog is for people who want to learn and practice playing the game of petanque. It's fun! And we will be happy to show you how to get started. LBC celebrates the game of petanque through friendship, community, and sharing of knowledge.

feeds.title: Main Ridge Bowls & Petanque Club Blog
feeds.description: Stay in the loop and read all recent news from Main Ridge Bowls & Pétanque Club. Founded in 1959. Main Ridge Bowls & Pétanque Club offers social and competitive lawn bowls & pétanque. With spaces available for events and functions.

feeds.title: St Anne's Park - Wednesday - Boules Group
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Tom Donnellan. I blog about the petanque events that are held at St Anne's Park. Come play with us!

feeds.title: Petanque Wallingford Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I want to remain anonymous for now but I am an even smarter mouse and I love to play petanque. I enjoy blogging about petanque. In my blog, you will find information about petanque events, coaching, petanque clubs, and more.

feeds.title: Cricklade Petanque Club
feeds.description: Cricklade Petanque Club loves to share updates about the petanque leagues and the players that play all around the world. Our goal is to promote the game and spread joy through it!
